scares.description: Louise opens the shower curtain and her dad is unexpectedly standing on the other side with his eyes turned white.
Michael turns on the light and his mom is standing behind him.
The phone suddenly rings during a quiet scene.
The phone once again rings during a quiet scene.
There is a cut to some loud chimes during a quiet scene.
There is a sudden sound of chains.
A silhouette suddenly jumps out right behind Michael up to his neck and screams “Out!”
Sudden knocking on the door scares Louise.
The nurse begins to scream from another room.
The dad springs up from the bed and attacks Louise.
